personality_one_liner: A disciplined, highly readable, and structured interface that respects the martial arts theme through clean typography and crisp blue-and-white contrast.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS padding. Avoid dense layouts; give elements breathing room.

do's: Use expo-blur on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
Use frosted glass over brand-tinted or photo backdrops for the featured cards.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form inputs.
Do not apply glass to list rows in dense lists.

screens.name: Auth / Login
screens.purpose: Classic username/password entry with martial arts textured background.

states.error: Standard inline red error text under input, shaking animation on failure.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (top-to-bottom transparent to surface). Floating surface card at the bottom 40% containing form fields and login CTA. Clean, single-column.

screens.name: Master Dashboard
screens.purpose: Admin hub to manage officials, create competitions, and view overall availability status.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for recent competitions and pending approvals.
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a tied belt, 'No active competitions. Add one to get started.'

screens.layout: Sticky header with glassmorphism. Top horizontal scroll of quick action chips ('Create Official', 'New Comp'). Below: 2-column grid for key metrics (Total Officials, Pending Confirmations). Bottom: vertically scrolling list of 'Upcoming Competitions'.

screens.name: Official Home
screens.purpose: Standard user view showing pending availability requests and confirmed upcoming competitions.

states.empty: 'No upcoming competitions. We will notify you when requested.' with abstract kimono background.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying the most immediate action (e.g., 'Availability Requested for Regional Championship') with Accept/Decline split buttons. Below: List of 'Confirmed Competitions' showing start date, end date, and address.

screens.name: Notifications Center
screens.purpose: Chronological list of all alerts (requests, confirmations, reminders) accessible via bell icon.

states.empty: Empty bell icon. 'You are all caught up.'
states.error: Error message with manual refresh CTA.

screens.layout: Simple vertical list. Unread items have a brandTertiary background. Read items have surface background. Swipe left to dismiss/delete.

screens.name: Attendance Register
screens.purpose: For Master to record physical presence of confirmed officials at the venue.
screens.layout: List of confirmed users with toggle switches (Present/Absent). Sticky primary CTA 'Save Attendance' at the bottom over scrolling content.

auth_background.alt: Close up of martial arts belt on kimono

hero_master.alt: Silhouette of a martial arts punch against sky

hero_official.alt: Martial arts belt resting on lap

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the blue and white palette specified ('Tema dell'app colori blu e bianco'). The UI must feel clean and disciplined.
Do NOT display faces in any martial arts imagery. Use the provided abstract textures, belts, and silhouettes.
Implement a mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top-to-bottom transparent to surfaceInverse) over the auth_background and hero image cards to ensure text readability.
For the Official creation flow, auto-generate or format the username as m.rossi based on the inputted first and last name.
Ensure the sticky primary CTA over scrolling content rule is applied in the Attendance Register (Save Attendance button).
Use standard Ionicons for the notification bell and navigation. Icons should be one weight/style (outlined-inactive / filled-active for tabs).
